releaseNotes:
Rookline 0.6.15 adds the new Rookline application identity, restores notification-area background behavior, retains measured Laguna Seca and Daytona sector references, and includes the latest session-engineer reliability improvements.

The Windows installers are not Authenticode-signed. Rookline verifies the published combined installer with the SHA-256 value in the HTTPS release manifest before updater launch.
